examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the site places it: the region overline, the headline and lead over the world map, four claim chips, and a floor of four client outcomes with their marks. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no title renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Both floors stacked: the `outcomes` kind closes the band with four client quotes on one column each, the `benefits` kind with three run-in benefits on its four-column floor, the fourth cell left empty as on azion.com. The map, title, lead and claims above are the same in both.

examples.name: Columns
examples.summary: The `outcomes` floor takes one column per entry, two at least and four at most: two, three and four outcomes. The `benefits` floor keeps four columns whatever it holds, so two, three and four benefits leave the trailing cells empty, as azion.com does.

site.name: ClientQuotes
site.summary: Four client outcomes on the floor, each a quote with its figure highlighted and signed by the client logo; Dafiti and Fourbank are drawn in one ink that follows the theme.

site.name: Benefits
site.summary: Three network benefits on the four-column floor, each a bold lead-in sentence running into its explanation, with no icon, as on azion.com's solution pages.
